originality.rationale: The previously published K_{2,n} result proves only the spanning-tree (j=1) spectrum; the new statement covers all j>=2 and has a two-mechanism unicyclic zero classification. General Krawtchouk shell transforms and graph Fourier formalism do not themselves present this fixed-cycle-excess graph spectrum. Searches and source readings below found no stated equivalent; an unindexed signed-enumerator specialization remains a genuine priority risk.
residual_risks: A classical signed reliability polynomial or complete weight enumerator evaluated at Boolean edge signs may subsume this graph specialization without matching its precise graph-Fourier wording.

The Krawtchouk identity is classical and reduces much of the proof to elementary coefficient extraction; the original contribution is a graph-specific all-excess interpretation, exact conditioning and unicyclic arithmetic rank.
